(Charlotte, North Carolina) | college = [[UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball|UNC Wilmington]] (2018–2022) | draft_year = 2022 | career_start = 2022 | years1 = [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2022]]–[[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team1 = [[Greensboro Swarm]] | years2 = {{nbay|2024|end}} | team2 = [[Charlotte Hornets]] | years3 = 2026–present | team3 = [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] | highlights = * [[List of NBA G League champions|NBA G League champion]] ([[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]]) * First-team All-[[Colonial Athletic Association|CAA]] (2022) }} '''Jaylen Terelle Sims''' (born December 11, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball|UNC Wilmington Seahawks]]. Sims played four seasons for the [[Greensboro Swarm]] of the [[NBA G League]] and is the team's all-time leading scorer. ==High school career== Sims is a native of [[Charlotte, North Carolina]], and attended [[United Faith Christian Academy]].{{cite web|first=Collin|last=Underwood|title=Charlotte's Jaylen Sims becomes second commit in UNCW basketball's 2018 class|url=https://theseahawk.org/14019/sports/charlottes-jaylen-sims-becomes-second-commit-in-uncw-basketballs-2018-class/|website=TheSeahawk.org|date=October 7, 2017|access-date=September 26, 2022}} He was recruited by UNC Wilmington Seahawks assistant coach Doug Esleeck who had first started recruiting Sims as an assistant for the [[Mercer Bears men's basketball|Mercer Bears]]. Sims' relationship with Esleeck was a major factor in his commitment to the Seahawks. ==College career== Sims led the Seahawks in scoring with 17.8 points per game as a junior in the 2020–21 season.{{cite web|first=Wajed|last=Doumani|title=UNC Wilmington guard Jaylen Sims has high expectations|url=https://bvmsports.com/2021/11/18/unc-wilmington-guard-jaylen-sims-has-high-expectations/|website=BVMSports.com|date=November 18, 2021|access-date=September 26, 2022}} He scored a career-high 29 points in a game against the [[Troy Trojans men's basketball|Troy Trojans]] on November 28, 2020.{{cite web | agency=Associated Press | title=Sims scores 29 to carry UNC-Wilmington over Troy 73-50 | website=Toronto Star | date=2020-11-28 | url=https://www.thestar.com/sports/sims-scores-29-to-carry-unc-wilmington-over-troy-73-50/article_5017253a-94a3-510d-ab0b-88b76d6b0dbf.html | access-date=2025-12-05}} Sims led the Seahawks in points (16.4), rebounds (5.5) and assists (2.4) per game during his senior season in 2021–22. He was selected to the first-team all-[[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA). The Seahawks won the [[2022 College Basketball Invitational]] and Sims was named as most outstanding player of the tournament.{{cite web|first=Zachary|last=Kilby|title=MBB wins first postseason championship in program history|url=https://theseahawk.org/33866/sports/mbb-wins-first-postseason-championship-in-program-history/|website=TheSeahawk.org|date=March 23, 2022|access-date=September 26, 2022}} Sims later declared for the NBA draft.{{cite web|title=24 Early-Entry Candidates Withdraw from NBA Draft 2022|url=https://www.nba.com/news/24-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-from-nba-draft-2022|website=NBA.com|date=June 16, 2022|access-date=September 26, 2022}} ==Professional career== === Greensboro Swarm / Charlotte Hornets (2022–2026) === After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Sims joined the [[Toronto Raptors]] for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=Sims Makes NBA Summer League Debut|url=https://uncwsports.com/news/2022/7/8/mens-basketball-sims-makes-nba-summer-league-debut.aspx|work=UNC Wilmington Sports|date=July 8, 2022|access-date=September 26, 2022}} and on September 12, 2022, Sims signed with the [[Charlotte Hornets]], his hometown team.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Crutcher, Duruji, Sims And Whaley|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-sign-crutcher-duruji-sims-and-whaley|website=NBA.com|date=September 12, 2022|access-date=September 26, 2022}}{{cite web|title=Hornets' |access-date=September 26, 2022}} He appeared in one preseason game before he was waived on October 14{{cite web|title=Hornets Waive Anthony Duruji And Jaylen Sims|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-waive-anthony-duruji-and-jaylen-sims|website=NBA.com|date=October 14, 2022|access-date=October 17, 2022}} and on November 4, he was named to the Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-announce-summer-league-minicamp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=June 30, 2023|access-date=July 11, 2023}} and on September 5, he signed with them.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Four Players|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-sign-four-players|website=NBA.com|date=September 5, 2023|access-date=September 8, 2023}} However, he was waived on September 29{{cite web|title=Hornets Waive Angelo Allegri, Tre Scott And Jaylen October 29.{{cite web|title=Greensboro Swarm Announce Training Camp Roster and Coaching Staff for 2023-24 Season|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/greensboro-swarm-announce-training-camp-roster-and-coaching-staff-for-2023-24-season|website=NBA.com|date=October 29, 2023|access-date=November 5, 2023}} Sims joined the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web |last1=Perley |first1=Sam |title=Jaylen Sims Savoring NBA Debut With Hometown Hornets |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/jaylen-sims-savoring-nba-debut-with-hometown-hornets |website=NBA |access-date=April 13, 2025 |date=April 12, 2025}} On September 28, 2024, he signed with the Hornets, but was waived the same day.{{cite web|title=Hornets Announce Roster Transactions|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-announce-roster-transactions|website=NBA.com|date=September 28, 2024|access-date=September 28, 2024}} On October 27, Sims rejoined the Swarm.{{cite web|title=Greensboro Swarm Announce Training Camp Roster for 2024-25 Season|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/greensboro-swarm-announce-training-camp-roster-for-2024-25-season|website=NBA.com|date=October 27, 2024|access-date=October 27, 2024}} He became the Swarm's all-time leading scorer during the 2024–25 season with 2,216 points. Sims led the Swarm to their first ever NBA G League playoff berth in 2025.{{cite web |title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Jaylen Sims |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-sign-jaylen-sims |website=NBA |access-date=April 13, 2025 |date=April 13, 2025}} On April 3, 2025, Sims signed a 10-day contract with the Hornets.{{Cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Jaylen Sims To 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-sign-jaylen-sims-to-10-day-contract|access-date=April 4, 2025|website=nba.com|language=en}} On April 13, he was signed for the remainder of the season. That night, he scored a career-high 12 points in a loss to the [[Boston Celtics]]. Sims averaged 7.0 points, 1.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists per game during his stint with the Hornets.{{cite web |title=Hornets' Jaylen Sims: Drops career-high 12 points |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/hornets-jaylen-sims-drops-career-high-12-points/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=July 11, 2025 |date=April 14, 2025}} Sims re-joined the Hornets for the [[2025 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web |title=Charlotte Hornets Announce Summer League Roster |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-announce-summer-league-roster-2 |website=NBA |access-date=July 11, 2025 |date=July 2, 2025}} On October 26, he was named to the Swarm's training camp roster for the 2025–26 season.{{cite web |title=Greensboro Swarm Announces 2025-26 Training Camp Roster |url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/greensboro-swarm-announces-2025-26-training-camp-roster |website=Greensboro Swarm |access-date=October 31, 2025 |date=October 26,
